g.text: Video → masks + point tracks + depth → a top-view drawing
Two pretrained networks feed classical vision and geometry. This is the actual case-sheet route, not a jointly trained network.

g.text: Raw tracks can bypass camera-support checks
Green: classical vision / geometry Blue + purple: neural modules Terracotta: drawing rules. Estimated overlay ≠ surveyed site trajectory.
Optional fallback in some cases: YOLOv8n-seg person masks + depth. Person-mask locations are not measured foot-contact positions.
